name: Keeping Your Promise
overview: Scripture emphasizes the solemn responsibility of keeping one's promises, particularly vows made to the LORD, as breaking them is considered sin and profaning God's name (Numbers 30:2; Deuteronomy 23:21). The integrity of one's word is highly valued, with the faithful being those who keep their oaths even to their own detriment (Psalms 15:4). God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises to Israel (Joshua 21:45) sets the standard for believers to honor their commitments, avoiding the folly of making vows lightly or seeking to evade them after the fact (Proverbs 20:25). The call to swear by the LORD and act accordingly underscores the sacredness of promises within a covenant relationship (Joshua 2:12).
